title: 6 LLM Optimization Tools Ranked for AI Visibility, 2026
summary: Compare 6 AI optimization tools ranked by monitoring coverage, pricing, and content workflows for November 2026 buyers.
body_markdown:
Your brand showing up in an AI answer doesn’t mean the answer gets your facts right. An AI crawler visiting your site doesn’t prove your brand appeared anywhere. Those are separate jobs, and a third sits behind them: turning what you find into reviewed content changes. Below, we sort six tools by what they track, how far their prompt and engine limits stretch, and which teams they suit.


**TLDR:**


- AI crawler visits aren't citations. Track your brand's mentions and factual accuracy separately.
- Match AI engine coverage to your buyers' questions, then check content and publishing workflows.
- Budget for your prompt count, engine count, and tracking frequency before buying.
- Treat rankings as research, not hands-on testing. Unverified features aren't absent features.
- Maintouch analytics starts at $149/month; broader agent capabilities use separate credit pricing.


## What Are AI Optimization Tools for AI Visibility?


An AI crawler visit is not a citation. AI optimization tools help you track and improve how your brand appears in AI answers, including mentions, citations, and factual accuracy.


Separate three capabilities:


- Simulated prompt tracking tests AI responses to your selected buyer questions.
- Observed agent visits show when AI crawlers or assistants access your site.
- Content execution turns findings into page edits or new content for your team to review and publish, following[GEO best practices](https://maintouch.com/blogs/best-geo-practices-complete-guide) .


> Access, visibility, and conversions are different signals.


Judge your results accordingly. Tracking tells you what happened; execution helps you act on it.


## How We Ranked AI Optimization Tools


Team fit beats feature count. We ranked tools using published product information, not hands-on testing. Our criteria:


- Answer coverage across AI engines and your buyers’ questions.
- Live agent traffic visibility with clear data sources.
- Findings that give you concrete next steps.
- Content review and publishing workflows.
- Integrations with your marketing stack.
- Usage allowances and contract requirements.


Features and prices are published facts. Recommendations are editorial judgment, and we left out comparisons we couldn't support. We sell Maintouch, so weigh our bias accordingly.


The[AI visibility tracker](https://maintouch.com/blogs/best-ai-brand-visibility-tracking-tools) shortlist below covers six tools: Maintouch, Scrunch, OtterlyAI, AthenaHQ, Peec AI, and Profound.


## Best Overall AI Optimization Tool: Maintouch


Visibility data alone won’t change a single page. Maintouch is our first pick because it connects the two. Yes, we’re recommending ourselves. Live agent traffic flows in through Cloudflare, Vercel, Kinsta, AWS CloudFront, or your server directly, so you see real AI visits next to your Search Console and Analytics data.


### What They Offer


- Persona-based prompt tracking, citation analysis, and false-claim detection against your knowledge base.
- Custom agents using your business context through 180+ connectors.
- Content workflows with CMS publishing and technical fixes.


Analytics starts at $149/month with a five-day trial. Broader agent capabilities have separate credit-based pricing, a key difference in our[Maintouch vs Profound](https://maintouch.com/blogs/maintouch-vs-profound) comparison.


Best for teams taking SEO and AI visibility measurement through to reviewed changes in one workspace.


Willow, a voice-dictation company, shows what that looks like in practice. It is now cited in 47% of its tracked prompts, according to its[Maintouch customer story](https://maintouch.com/customers/willow) . Allan Guo, Co-Founder & CEO at[Willow](https://maintouch.com/customers/willow) , put it this way: "Since working with them, we've seen a massive increase in our AI visibility, and it's quickly becoming a core growth channel for us."


## Scrunch


Visibility totals aren't enough when you need audience comparisons. Scrunch’s[documented monitoring features](https://www.scalenut.com/blogs/scrunch-ai-review) support that closer look.


### What They Offer


- Track citations and prompt-level answer share to see where your brand appears.
- Benchmark by persona, topic, geography, and competitor to compare visibility across segments.


If those comparisons drive your reporting, shortlist Scrunch. If you’re also considering Peec AI for monitoring, see our[Maintouch vs Peec AI](https://maintouch.com/blogs/maintouch-vs-peec) breakdown. The cited review provides no concrete plan restrictions, so confirm limits before buying.


Maintouch is our product, so discount accordingly. Pick Scrunch if monitoring is the whole job. Look at Maintouch if you also need content workflows, technical fixes, and publishing.


## OtterlyAI


A low entry price isn't your whole monitoring budget. OtterlyAI’s November 2026 announcement lists Lite at[$29/month](https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/11/10/3399428/0/en/otterlyai-ai-search-analytics-from-29-a-month-now-with-any-3-to-7-ai-engines-of-your-choice.html) for only 15 prompts on four engines. The three-to-seven-engine flexibility applies to the broader plan update, not Lite’s entry allowance; your engine selection and tracking frequency shape credit usage.


### What They Offer


- Choose three to seven AI engines per workspace to match your monitoring needs.
- Use credit top-ups and a weekly tracking option to manage your usage.


If you're testing an AI search analytics budget, OtterlyAI belongs on your shortlist.


We build Maintouch, so take our view with a grain of salt. If you need live agent traffic and a way to act on what you find, look past basic monitoring.


## AthenaHQ


Your monitoring schedule matters more than the sticker price. AthenaHQ suits teams budgeting AI visibility around response credits, with[credit-based monitoring and recommendations](https://alexandrya.ai/en/blog/athenahq-review) .


### What They Offer


- AI answer monitoring that uses one credit per response.
- Content and outreach recommendations based on visibility findings.


Reported Starter pricing is $295/month for 3,600 credits. Multiply your prompt count by engine count and tracking frequency before buying.


For comparison, Maintouch offers connected agents and publishing workflows. Our contracted Custom plans also include Forward Deployed Marketer support for strategy and agent configuration.


## Peec AI


More tracking isn't automatically better. Peec AI fits your team if you want a defined monitoring allowance. Its[published tracking plan details](https://xtrusio.com/blog/peec-ai-pricing-plans-prompt-limits) cover prompt and engine limits; confirm project allowances before subscribing.


### What They Offer


- Starter includes 50 prompts across three selected AI models. Xtrusio reports $95/month, but sources differ on the amount and currency; confirm your applicable price with Peec AI before buying.
- Pro includes 150 prompts; Advanced includes 350.


Check engine coverage against the tools your buyers use.


If you need context-aware content creation, technical fixes, and publishing, we'd point you to Maintouch (yes, you're reading our blog). The difference is scope.


## Profound


Profound goes beyond visibility tracking: it also offers agents for content research and drafting, according to this[features and pricing review](https://strategi.is/blogs/profound-review-what-it-does-what-it-costs-and-what-it-wont-do) .


### What They Offer


- Track your brand during a trial across ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.
- Use AI agents to research and draft your content, though some teams prefer comparing[Profound alternatives](https://maintouch.com/blogs/profound-alternatives) first.


Shortlist it if you want a custom enterprise arrangement. Reported brand access starts with a seven-day trial, followed by custom Enterprise pricing; see our breakdown of[Profound AI pricing](https://maintouch.com/blogs/profound-ai-pricing) for details. Agencies have a separate purchasing route.


For ongoing self-serve analytics, Maintouch’s entry plan offers another option, with broader execution priced separately.

## FAQ


### How should you choose among Maintouch, Scrunch, OtterlyAI, AthenaHQ, Peec AI, and Profound?


Start with the work your team needs to finish, not the longest feature list. Shortlist Scrunch for audience comparisons, OtterlyAI or Peec AI for monitoring budgets, AthenaHQ for monitoring plus recommendations, and Maintouch or Profound for content work. Before buying, confirm engine coverage, usage limits, and whether your quote includes drafting, review, or publishing.


### Should you start with OtterlyAI or Peec AI before considering Maintouch or Profound?


A smaller monitoring scope is a sensible starting point if you are new to AI visibility and already have people who can act on findings. Compare OtterlyAI’s engine choices and credit usage with Peec AI’s prompt allowances; consider Maintouch or Profound when your team also needs content workflows. Your workload matters more than your experience level.


### How can you compare monthly costs across AthenaHQ, OtterlyAI, Peec AI, and Maintouch?


Use the same prompt set, engine count, and tracking schedule for every quote. For AthenaHQ, 39 prompts across three engines checked daily for 30 days would fit within its reported Starter allowance of 3,600 response credits. Ask OtterlyAI about top-ups, Peec AI about prompt and project limits, and Maintouch about execution credits beyond analytics.


### How should you test Maintouch, Scrunch, or Profound before committing?


Give each vendor the same buyer questions, competitor list, and target AI engines, then compare citation accuracy and the usefulness of its findings. Ask for a walkthrough of one real task, from a missing brand mention to a proposed content change. Confirm every required capability directly: an unverified feature is a question for the vendor, not proof that it is absent.


### Can you use Maintouch, AthenaHQ, or Profound reports to prove AI visibility drives sales?


Visibility reports alone do not prove sales impact, and AI crawler visits do not prove citations. Pair monitoring results with referral traffic and conversion data, keep your tracked questions consistent, and log content changes by date. Treat those signals as evidence to investigate, not automatic proof that a tool caused revenue growth.


### What is the difference between AI visibility tracking and AI crawler analytics?


AI visibility tracking simulates buyer questions and records whether your brand is mentioned or cited in the answers. AI crawler analytics records live visits from AI agents and assistants to your site. One shows what AI says about you; the other shows who is reading your pages. Check both, because neither proves the other.


### How many prompts should you track for AI visibility?


Start with the questions your buyers actually ask, then grow the list as you learn which ones matter. Published allowances vary widely: OtterlyAI's Lite plan lists 15 prompts, while Peec AI's plans run from 50 to 350. Pick the tool whose allowance fits your question list instead of padding prompts to fill a tier.


### How often should you track AI answers?


Match your tracking schedule to how fast your content and market change. Daily checks catch changes sooner but use more credits on credit-based tools like AthenaHQ, which uses one credit per response. A weekly option, like the one OtterlyAI offers, keeps costs lower when your pages change slowly.


### Why do AI answers about your brand differ from buyer to buyer?


AI assistants carry some memory about each user, so a senior marketer and an agency owner can get different answers to the same question. Maintouch handles this with buyer personas that add context to its simulated prompts, and it can run multi-turn conversations to mirror a real buying process. Track more than one persona if your buyers vary.


### What counts as a false claim in an AI answer, and how do you catch it?


A false claim is a statement an AI assistant makes about your brand that your own documentation contradicts, such as a wrong feature or price. Maintouch checks each tracked response against your knowledge base and context documents, then traces the claim back to the cited sources. If the source is a page on your site, it proposes an update for your review.


### Which AI engines should an AI optimization tool cover?


Cover the engines your buyers use. Maintouch tracks prompts across major AI assistants including ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity. For any other tool, confirm which engines your plan includes, since some plans limit you to a selected number of models.


### Can Maintouch show which AI crawlers visit your site?


Yes. Maintouch tracks live agent traffic by connecting to Cloudflare, Vercel, Kinsta, or AWS CloudFront, or by connecting your server directly. This is observed data, separate from the simulated prompt tracking, so you can compare what AI agents fetch with what AI answers say about you.


### Can you publish content straight from an AI optimization tool?


It depends on the tool, so ask each vendor to show it. Maintouch connects to most major CMSs for publishing, and you decide how far automation goes, from flagging updates to scheduling or auto-publishing. You can also add approval workflows so a person signs off before anything goes live.
